# People

This area groups the individuals who drive, govern, and contribute to the Danish national clinical quality databases, with a primary focus on the Danish Quality Database for Inflammatory Bowel Disease (DANIBD). It encompasses the medical professionals, health leaders, epidemiologists, and data managers who steer cross-regional quality measurement and guideline development, alongside data governance experts ensuring regulatory compliance, patient representatives integrating the user perspective, and researchers providing the epidemiological evidence base.

## Pages

- [[entities/people/data-governance/index|Data Governance]] — Professionals overseeing regulatory compliance, data protection, and information integrity for national health registries.
- [[entities/people/data-managers/index|Data Managers]] — Technical and operational leaders at RKKP responsible for data collection, quality assurance, and standardized reporting.
- [[entities/people/epidemiologists/index|Epidemiologists]] — Specialists driving national quality measurement, clinical benchmarking, and evidence-based guideline development for IBD treatment.
- [[entities/people/health-leaders/index|Health Leaders]] — Senior administrators and chief physicians guiding the strategic direction and cross-regional quality monitoring of national databases.
- [[entities/people/healthcare-professionals/index|Healthcare Professionals]] — Medical professionals, clinical lecturers, and specialty nurses representing Denmark's five regions on the DANIBD steering committee.
- [[entities/people/patient-representatives/index|Patient Representatives]] — Individuals ensuring the patient perspective is actively integrated into the design and assessment of clinical quality indicators.
- [[entities/people/researchers/index|Researchers]] — Authors of pivotal validation studies that confirm the reliability and accuracy of diagnostic codes in national patient registries.
